default_output_columns.description: Comma-separated list of columns for the default output. Corresponds to rfkill --output.

default_block_types.description: List of rfkill types to block by default. Corresponds to rfkill block <type>.

output_json.description: If true, enables JSON output format by default. Corresponds to rfkill -J.

no_headings.description: If true, hides the header line in output. Corresponds to rfkill -n.
